gold.description: The A1 primary brand color. Use for primary decorative accents, headline text on dark backgrounds, or background color on small layout surface areas.

charcoal.description: Use primarily for text and background colors on small layout surfaces.

white.description: Use for text on dark backgrounds or for secondary decorative accent elements.

cerulean.description: This is the primary color for interaction in light mode or on light surface areas. Use for hyperlinks, primary calls-to-action, active/selected states on interactive controls. Never use for surface background color.

darkCerulean.description: Use primarily for background color on dark layout surfaces.

lightGold.description: Use for text on dark backgrounds or background colors on small to medium layout surface areas.
